content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Recursion and Tail Recursion** as part of **Functional Programming and Idiomatic Kotlin**. Apply recursion and tail recursion by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Recursive Function Design, Base Cases and Recursive Cases, tailrec and Its Limitations—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
